description: Asks which functions the expression service evaluates in a Recordset.Filter and Recordset.Sort on a dynaset over Mx, and the rows a recordset opened from each Filter returns: Null and Nz tests, Len, InStr, Mid, Format, CInt on a text column that does not convert, an unknown function, CurDir and Environ, IIf, DateDiff, and a Sort with a plain field, a descending field, a field list and a function. A rejected Filter or Sort is an observation; the Filter is cleared before each Sort. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
